question: Will Como 1907 beat Udinese at 90 mins + added time in their Serie A match on Aug 22, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Como 1907's official full-time score is strictly greater than Udinese's official full-time score at the end of 90 minutes plus referee-added stoppage time in the Serie A match between Udinese and Como 1907 scheduled for 22 August 2026.
- "No": Wins if Udinese's official full-time score is strictly greater than Como 1907's official full-time score at the end of 90 minutes plus referee-added stoppage time in that match.
- "Draw": Wins if both teams have an equal official full-time score at the end of 90 minutes plus referee-added stoppage time in that match.

Clarifications:
- Settlement is based solely on the scoreline at the conclusion of 90 minutes plus referee-added stoppage time; any goals scored in extra time or results from a penalty shoot-out are excluded.
- If the match is postponed and takes place before the market's settlement time, the result of the rescheduled match applies; if the match is cancelled or not played before the market's settlement time, all outcomes are void.
